subject: mittens
name: 连指手套
label: 圆头小手套
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One mitten with a clear thumb lobe and one cuff band.
Elegant simple hand-drawn dark contours and white empty interiors. No gray shading, no fabric knit texture, no tiny repeated ridges, no extra motifs. Any requested snowflake is one simple six-arm shape without tiny branching details. Complete subject within 10 percent clear margins.
